# Locked reduced Tika research runtime

Apache Tika source revision: `f45b9498f35d55445af28737407586362b2e37fc`, retrieved from `https://github.com/apache/tika`. The existing reduced research build compiles annotation declarations, core, XMP and PDF modules only. No upstream implementation source, JAR, JDK or new application dependency is added to this repository by the application integration.

`LICENSE-tika.txt`, `NOTICE-tika.txt` and `LICENSE-tika-core-additions.txt` are exact copies of the pinned upstream root licence/notice and core appended licence. They retain their full wording, including aggregate terms for components that are not part of this selected classpath. The existence of an aggregate notice is not evidence that every named dependency is installed. File hashes and the actually inspected PDF sources are recorded in `research/tika/application-inspection.json`.

Actual runtime JAR/source/POM pairs remain in ignored `.research-cache/tika-runtime/`; the existing lock `research/runtime_artifacts/tika-research-artifacts.json` records their exact bytes, dependency edges, declared licences and embedded notices. Static acquisition/inspection replay verified the unchanged 18 pairs/66 files in this batch without executing a JAR. Apache-2.0, MIT and BSD-2-Clause components remain individually identified there. Picocli's corresponding source header supplies its attribution/licence information where the binary lacks an embedded licence. The reduced build retains upstream terms in its JAR; staging also preserves the upstream root notices beside that JAR. Dependency source/notice copies must remain available for any eventual distribution review.

The JDK/base image's full source/licence closure and publisher-signature verification remain open. Root Apache metadata is not blanket approval for MIME/data contributions, dependency licences or a container distribution. No shipping, legal, vulnerability, sandbox or production approval is asserted. See docs110 for historical research evidence and `docs/136_TIKA_APPLICATION_WORKER.md` for this application's unrun acceptance and gates.
